reason: Different products: HealthEquity is an HSA custodian and consumer-directed benefits administrator (HSA, FSA, COBRA, commuter). CorVel is a workers' comp, auto and liability claims and managed care services provider. The only overlap is that both sell to US employers (and some insurers/health plans). Both earn service fees, but HealthEquity also earns custodial and interchange income. That is a customer-only overlap, so adjacent.
